title: Long-term stay in and exit from macrophages of Candida glabrata
description: The Candida glabrata WT (ATCC2001) was exposed to human monocyte-derived macrophages (hMDMs) for a prolonged stay in the phagosome for up to 80h. Comparisons include an uninfected control and an infection with the yeast-locked Candida albicans mutant strain, efg1/cph1.
